_about: Breadboard's own words to participants, in English: the server's pages and end screens (app/), the engine's (groovy/) and the participant page's (frontend/client), which all read this file. zho.json has them in Chinese. {name} is filled in; a text with "one" and "other" is chosen by {n}. Change a text here, not in the code.
signIn.title: Join the session
signIn.lead: Enter the ID you were given to take your seat.
signIn.idTooLong: This ID is too long. Please use the ID you were given (at most 64 characters).
signIn.idReserved: This ID is reserved. Please use the ID you were given.
signIn.testSession: This session isn't running right now. Please check the link you were given.
signIn.idInUse: This ID is already in use. If it is yours, open the study in the browser where you first signed in; otherwise, check the ID you were given.
signIn.inviteUsed: This invitation link has already been used.
seat.title: You're already taking part
seat.lead: This browser has a seat in the session as {id}.
link.invalid: There is no study session at this address. Please check that you opened the whole link you were given, or contact the researcher.
link.invalidInvite: This invitation link isn't valid. Please check the link you were given, or contact the researcher.
notRunning.pageTitle: This session isn't running right now
notRunning.page: It has finished, or was interrupted (for example by a server restart). If you were given a link to the study, open it again to join the session that is open now; otherwise, please contact the researcher.
notRunning.title: This session isn't running
notRunning.text: It may have ended, or it hasn't been opened yet. If you were given a link to the study, open it again; otherwise you can close this page.
started.title: The session has already started
started.signIn: This session began before you arrived, so it can't take anyone new. Please contact the researcher.
started.invite: This session began before you arrived, so it takes no one new. Please contact the researcher.
started.prolific: This session began before you arrived. Please return the study on Prolific.
started.screen: It began before you arrived, so it can't take anyone new. Please contact the researcher.
noSession.title: No session is open right now
noSession.text: There is no session taking participants at the moment. Please try again in a few minutes, or contact the researcher.
noSession.prolific: There is no session taking participants at the moment. Please return the study on Prolific.
holding.underWay: The next one opens as soon as it has ended, and this page takes you into it by itself: please keep it open.
holding.underWayProlific: The next one opens as soon as it has ended, and this page takes you into it by itself, so you can keep it open. If you can't wait, please return the study on Prolific.
holding.soon: It opens in a moment, and this page takes you into it by itself: please keep it open.
holding.soonProlific: It opens in a moment, and this page takes you into it by itself, so you can keep it open. If you can't wait, please return the study on Prolific.
prolific.missingId: This link must be opened from Prolific. Please return to Prolific and start the study again.
prolific.notRunning: There is no session running at the moment. Please return the study on Prolific.
prolific.joined: You have already joined this study in another browser or tab. Please continue there.
takenPart.title: You have already taken part in this study
takenPart.withCode: Thank you for taking part. You can't take part a second time, but here is your completion code again.
takenPart.orEnter: Or enter the code above on Prolific.
takenPart.noCode: Thank you for taking part. You can't take part a second time. If you still need your completion code, please message the researcher on Prolific.
end.title: This session has ended
end.thanks: Thank you for taking part. You can close this page.
end.closeOrAsk: You can close this page; if you have any questions, please contact the researcher.
end.stopped: The researcher stopped this session. If they start it again, open the link you were given once more. Otherwise, thank you for taking part: you can close this page.
end.serverStopped: It ended because the study's server was stopped or restarted.
end.serverStoppedOther: If you were given a link to the study, you can open it again in a few minutes to join the session that is open then; otherwise, thank you for taking part, and please contact the researcher if you have any questions.
end.serverStoppedProlific: You can open the study again from Prolific in a few minutes to join the session that is open then. If no session is open, please return the study on Prolific, and message the researcher there if you have any questions.
end.outOfTime: It ran out of time. Thank you for taking part.
end.outOfTimeProlific: It ended before the study gave you a completion code, so please message the researcher on Prolific about your submission.
end.problem: It had to stop because of a problem with the study. Thank you for taking part.
end.problemProlific: You can open the study again from Prolific later to join a new session, if one is open then. Otherwise, please return the study on Prolific, and message the researcher there if you have any questions.
end.missedStart: The session started while your connection was lost, so it went ahead without you, and it can't take you in any more.
end.missedStartOther: You can close this page. If you have any questions, please contact the researcher.
end.missedStartProlific: Please return the study on Prolific. You can then close this page.
end.full: It started with as many people as it can take, so it can't take you in.
end.fullNext: The next session opens as soon as this one has ended. {link}: the page waits for it to open and takes you in.
end.fullOther: You can close this page. If you have any questions, please contact the researcher.
end.fullNextProlific: The next session opens as soon as this one has ended: open the study again from Prolific to join it (the page waits for it to open), or return the study on Prolific if you can't wait.
end.fullProlific: Please return the study on Prolific, and message the researcher there if you have any questions.
end.notInGame: {id} isn't in this session's game right now, so there is nothing to show. A preview adds nobody to the game: participants join from their own page. Reload this preview once they have joined.
waiting.title: Waiting for the others

waiting.startsWhen.one: The session starts when {target} person is here.
waiting.startsWhen.other: The session starts when {target} people are here.

waiting.startsIn: That's enough to begin: the session starts in about {s} s.
waiting.startsInOrMax: That's enough to begin: the session starts in about {s} s, or as soon as {max} are here.
waiting.startsShortly: That's enough to begin: the session starts shortly.
waiting.startsShortlyOrMax: That's enough to begin: the session starts shortly, or as soon as {max} are here.
waiting.keepOpen: Please keep this page open. It will change by itself when the session starts.
waiting.notEnough: Thank you for waiting. This session could not start.
connection.lost: Connection lost. Trying to reconnect… Please keep this page open.
connection.blocked: This page can’t open its live connection to the study; the network may block it. Please try another network (e.g. mobile data) or browser.
connection.elsewhere: This study is open in another tab or window.
connection.ended: This session is over. You can close this page.
connection.reconnectingChoices: Reconnecting… you can answer once the connection is back.
game.beginsShortly: The study will begin shortly. This page will change by itself.
game.nextPart: The next part will appear here by itself.
network.reconnecting: Reconnecting… you can change ties once the connection is back.
network.chooseSecond: Now choose who {name} should be connected with.
network.noChangeNow: There is no change you can make right now.
network.allChangesMade: You have made all the changes you can for now.
network.noList: No changes to list right now
network.showList: Show the changes as a list ({n} possible)
network.noOneLeft: {name} has no one left to connect with.
network.noLongerPossible: That change is no longer possible.
edgeEdit.tooLate: Time was up for that change, so it wasn't made.
edgeEdit.notNow: Editing ties is not possible right now.
edgeEdit.noMoreAdds: No more ties can be added.
edgeEdit.noMoreCuts: No more ties can be cut.
edgeEdit.notOnOffer: That change is not on offer.
edgeEdit.amongNeighbors: Both people must be among your connections.
edgeEdit.ownOnly: You can only change your own ties.
edgeEdit.withVisible: You can only change ties with people you can see.
edgeEdit.betweenVisible: You can only change ties between people you can see.
finish.refused: Your comment couldn’t be saved, so the researcher won’t get it this way. Try again, or copy it and send it to the researcher through Prolific’s messages.
finish.lost: Your comment may not have reached the researcher: the server couldn’t be reached, or didn’t confirm it. Try again, or copy it and send it to the researcher through Prolific’s messages.
finish.unconfirmed: Your comment hasn’t been confirmed yet: the server hasn’t answered. This page goes on to Prolific by itself once the server has saved it. You can also try again, or copy your comment and send it to the researcher through Prolific’s messages.
finish.ifNothing: If nothing happens, open {url}, or enter the code above on Prolific.
ready.pending: The game will begin shortly. When a “Ready” button appears, press it to begin the task.
ready.prompt: Press the "Ready" button before the timer expires to begin this task.
ready.waiting: The game will begin shortly. Please wait for other players.
